messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
Our latest forecast for part:350011 grows +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge the verified increase in your volume forecast and agree to implement the CU-NOTATION index clause, which allows for a significantly lower base price. 

Consequently, we can accept your terms and await your order based on our offer of a price of €361.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Please note that our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. However, our colleagues will address your request for a cost breakdown in due course.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor (2)
messages.body:
Thank you for agreeing. One question before we place the order: our controlling prefers a fixed price without the index clause. Could you confirm the attached fixed-price package at 367.04 EUR per unit? If not, your agreed offer stands for us.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
